execution: Codex collaboration agents, local cached JSON files; no model API client or paid model endpoint
source_preparation: Source-only annotation before response generation. Initial sources/annotations retained. One overlap-contaminated source replaced deterministically before freezing and generation; eight original source/annotation records preserved unchanged.

generation.workers: One fresh isolated-context agent per arm; shared inherited runtime, no model override
generation.response_policy: First output only, UTF-8 pending file then atomic rename without overwrite; no quality retries
generation.revised_product_identity: Every revised input is asserted byte-for-byte equal to prepare_summary_contract(...).task_requests.en during freeze
generation.exact_runtime_model_and_decoding: Not independently exposed; do not infer a paid-API model identity from an agent nickname

review.validation: Schema, IDs, exact quote evidence and identical-output consistency; no feedback-driven regrading

root_audit: After both saved reviews, aggregate scores and source-audit omissions plus lexical/semantic discrepancies. Preserve original grades.
cost_scope: No paid model API charges were incurred by this run. Codex usage was consumed; this is not a claim of cost-free production inference.
future_use: These nine evaluation sources are now observed and must be excluded from any later claimed fresh final evaluation.
